title: Duplicate settlement
agentPrompt: Repair settlement idempotency so concurrent duplicate deliveries produce exactly one financial effect without relying on JVM memory, Redis, or Kafka offsets. Preserve retry safety across restarts and explain the transaction boundary.
publicChecks: The same message ID delivered 100 times produces one ledger transaction
The same business key with a different message ID remains idempotent
A database rollback does not leave a completed inbox record
